source: Project Operating System Phase 4 - Validation Engine
description: Declarative compliance rules for future validation decisions.

rules.description: Testing approval must exist before a component can be validated.
Migration approval is required when the component is linked to a migration.
All required checklist items must pass or have accepted manual review.
No critical nonconformity may remain open.
Manual approval must be recorded before approval.
Recurring behavior should be controlled by configuration before code.
POS records must not become the source of legal or labor knowledge.

notes: Rules define compliance decisions and do not enforce them automatically.
